text: `get-api-workspace` answers `WorkspaceResponse` (name, kind, lastOpenedProject), but the same path `GET /api/workspace` already served the UI's project listing (mode, defaultPort, lastOpened, projects[] with id/name/cwd/live) that the switcher, /welcome, `c4s` `confirmRemoteProject` and the e2e helpers read. The L4 todo says the UI registry route with the project list has no settled method or path yet. Assumed: the route answers the three DTO fields plus the existing listing fields, until the listing gets its own route.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0601 — GET /api/workspace carries the WorkspaceResponse fields plus the UI's existing project listing (mode, defaultPort, lastOpened, projects) until that listing has a route of its own.
